newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Bionx Implants started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bionx Implants started as buy.

text.p: UBS Securities said it started coverage of Bionx Implants Inc with a buy rating.
-- Shares rose 1/8 to 15-7/8, touched new high of 16-1/4.
-- Analyst Samuel Navarro gave Bionx a 12 to 18 month price target in the "low-to-mid-$20s."
-- said he expects 1997 EPS $0.21, $0.74 in 1998 and $1.23 in 1999. Bionx earned $0.02 in 1997 Q1.

-- UBS was the lead underwriter of the Malvern, Pa., company's April IPO. Bionx has a proprietary polymer technology platform that eliminates the limitations of current resorbable and metal implants used in orthopaedics and other fields. The implants, such as screws, pins, arrows and stents, can be used in orthopaedics, urology and maxillo-facial.
